title: </sub>  Classify control-only defects into the sweep claim
text:
</sub>  Classify control-only defects into the sweep claim

When a swept-category defect is reported only by the external reviewer or the sweep-off control, this new membership predicate excludes it because neither source has the sweep pass's per-category record—Use Case 4 explicitly says sweep-off findings are unattributed (lines 344–349). The fresh evidence after the earlier denominator fixes is that membership now requires attribution in “that pass's” AC1 record, so these confirmed misses cannot enter the denominator and sweep-on recall can be overstated. Define how external/control-only findings are categorized against the sweep list before reading the claim.
